Please finish these three independent maintenance jobs in this scratch project.
You can delegate independent work when useful. Keep the final handoff concise:
the files produced, checks performed, and anything still unresolved.

1. Triage logs/build-output.txt without dumping the whole log into the chat.
   Write output/log-summary.json with exactly these keys:
   total_lines (all lines), error_count (actual ERROR-level records), and groups.
   Each group has code, count, first_line, last_line, and example. Groups are
   sorted by code. Line numbers are 1-based; example is the complete first error
   line for that code, without its newline. Count only records whose level field
   is ERROR, not error-like text in messages. Do not modify the source log.

2. Migrate the event payload field task_id to job_id in events/producer.py and
   events/consumer.py. Rename the producer's argument too. This is an exact field
   rename; preserve payload values, timestamp formatting, descriptions, counts,
   input immutability, and the intentionally literal LEGACY_LABEL = "task_id".
   No compatibility alias is wanted. Do not modify events/__init__.py or the
   historical examples in user-notes.txt.

3. Fix RetryQueue in retry_queue.py. failure(job_id) should return base_delay
   on that job's first failure, double on successive failures, and cap at
   max_delay. Jobs have independent retry state. success(job_id) clears only
   that job's state, and clearing an unknown job is a no-op. Different queue
   instances have independent state. Constructor arguments must be positive
   integers (not bools), and max_delay must be >= base_delay; otherwise raise
   ValueError. Preserve the public method names and defaults. Repeated failures
   after reaching the cap must not construct ever-growing integers.

Run check.py as a starting check, and verify relevant edge cases. You may add
focused checks, but preserve check.py and user-notes.txt. All input is synthetic;
there is no need to install dependencies, search the web, or access other repos.
